Age at maturity is 70 years with the following conditions: a. Salary for Non-Golden Visa Holders should be AED 40,000 or more & for Golden Visa Holders, AED 30,000 or more. b. To avail a maximum of 80% financing (Finance to Value Ratio - FTV), the age of the customer must be 55 years or less at the time of applying for the finance. c. To avail a maximum of 70% financing (Finance to Value Ratio - FTV), the age of the customer must be between 55 years and 58 years at the time of applying for the finance and the finance tenure needs to be aligned to ensure that the Debt Burden Ratio (DBR) is maximized to 50%. d. Length of Service should be greater than 2 years. e. Mandatory Insurance coverage for Life is required including Permanent and Total Disability (PTD) until 70 years.
